hotel_ibisair.en: Re-checked 19 Nov 2026 for 17–18 Aug (free cancellation, A/C): Same building: TRIBE Budapest Airport €269 (Booking 9.0, 4,150 reviews; 'Tribe Max' room for 4, breakfast €22 per person extra).
